Poly Dip 2 Multiplayer

The PD2 multiplayer mod for PolyTrack 0.6.3, including lobby discovery, run-preserving host migration, height tracking, spectating, horns, chat and proximity voice.

Use a clean PML installation. Do not combine with the standalone PD2 app.asar or the original PolyDip mod.

Original PolyDip by DoraChad + Orangy. PD2 commissioned by Zeptjan. Public edition: owner moderation remains in the separate Electron build.
